items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You could be Jay Gould one day and Jay Bird the next in the same day.

ctx.x: When you say that, how long would the average career of that one artist at a time be in vogue before they fell from popularity and the industry was looking for another one?
I think as long as the public liked them. You could be Jay Gould one day and Jay Bird the next in the same day.
One piece of information that I’ve come across in some of the writings about that I’m very unclear about says that you studied Psychology at the University of Chicago in the 1940’s, yes or no?
